idea.title: From photos to video: how it works
idea.angle: I show the simple process: you send the listing photos, AI adds slow camera moves to each one, then we add the hook, captions and the ask. No crew, no reshoot.
idea.hook: YOUR PHOTOS IN. A SMOOTH VIDEO OUT.

slides.heading: YOUR PHOTOS IN. A SMOOTH **VIDEO** OUT.
A GOOD VIDEO NEEDS A FILM DAY
YOUR PHOTOS ARE **ENOUGH**
slides.body: AI can turn the listing photos you already have into smooth, cinematic video.

slides.heading: START WITH THE **PHOTOS**
slides.body: Bright, tidy, taken from the corner of each room. Best shot first.

slides.heading: ADD SLOW **CAMERA** MOVES
slides.body: Each photo gets a calm, smooth move. Two to three seconds per shot.

slides.heading: ADD THE **HOOK**
slides.body: Your best shot with bold text, like "4-bed with pool, quiet street."

slides.heading: END WITH ONE **ASK**
slides.body: Price, location and one clear action, like "DM TOUR to book a viewing."

slides.heading: GET THE 15-SECOND **FORMULA**
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
No crew. No reshoot. No editing at night.

Here is how a listing video gets made from photos.
Start with bright, tidy photos, best shot first.
AI adds a slow, smooth camera move to each one.
Then add a bold hook at the start and one clear ask at the end.
The result is a 15-second video of the real home.

Which listing would you turn into a video first?

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
